headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting very high revenue gains while others saw modest or slowing expansion.
summary: Coforge led with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Mid‑tier players such as LTM, Mphasis and Tech Mahindra delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑led deals. Larger peers like Infosys and TCS posted modest 1‑2% constant‑currency growth, and Infosys trimmed its FY27 outlook. Profitability was mixed, with Wipro and Infosys seeing profit pressure despite revenue gains.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted strong AI contributions, with AI revenue up 29% at Infosys and 47% at LTM, driving larger deal wins.

themes.title: Margin guidance shifts
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin target to 16%, while Infosys cut FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1‑2%.

themes.title: Headcount and attrition trends
themes.detail: HCLTech added 6,450 staff, but attrition remained high at 12.8%; Wipro saw a net headcount decline of 6,716.
